use: WMTS layer JEZ_hirise_soc_006_orthoMosaic_25cm_Eqc_latTs0_lon0_first_dd (MRO HiRISE Jezero controlled mosaic): GetCapabilities parsed, 36 zoom-15 tiles fetched and registered against the USGS orthomosaic and the DTM (scientific-pipeline/evidence/cross_validation_report.json, checks X2a/X2b).

The terrain source product is catalogued in Mars Trek as 'MRO HiRISE, Jezero DEM, Controlled' (item_UUID c3935915-9abe-4d8c-a87c-b96d195a8cfd, productLabel JEZ_hirise_soc_006_DTM_MOLAtopography_DeltaGeoid_1m_Eqc_latTs0_lon0_blend40). Ausnox downloaded the USGS-distributed GeoTIFF of that product; the Mars Trek catalog lists 1,839,718,122 bytes versus 1,839,545,409 bytes for the USGS file, so the two files are not byte-identical packages of the product.

Raw-image metadata for sols 490 and 690 (site/drive 26/1004 and 32/1184) links the cited science targets to rover positions (scientific-pipeline/config/jezero_p0.json) and provides the rover-clock cross-check of the Mars24 implementation (packages/scientific-engine/tests/solar.test.ts).

tls_note: The site served an incomplete certificate chain (leaf CN=www.space.apps.nasa.gov, issuer 'SSL.com TLS Issuing RSA CA R1', intermediate not sent). The intermediate was fetched from the leaf's AIA URL http://cert.ssl.com/SSL.com-TLS-I-RSA-R1.cer, verified with `openssl verify` against the certifi Mozilla root store (chains to 'SSL.com TLS RSA Root CA 2022'), and the page was then fetched with full verification (curl --cacert bundle, 'Verify return code: 0 (ok)'). Verification was never disabled.
